# Overtime isn’t just 1.5× the base rate.

> Free calculator for Davis-Bacon / prevailing-wage certified payroll: checks whether a worker's cash wages plus fringe meet the wage determination, and computes overtime correctly when part of the fringe is paid in cash instead of a bona fide plan.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
